Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is soliciting proposals for a refresh of laptops to accommodate MD529 employees. The procurement scope requires the acquisition of 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops that are Microsoft Copilot ready, along with 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4). Deliverables include a 3-year Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extended for all machines purchased, with a warranty certificate or affidavit to be presented upon award. All items have a required due and delivery date of June 10, 2024. As stated in the business need, the "Office is in need of a refresh of laptops and must acquire enough laptops to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in our staff as of June 1, 2023."

sources.quote: Office is in need of a refresh of laptops and must acquire enough laptops to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in our staff as of June 1, 2023.

Bid Summary.notes: Synthesized summary based on project description, requested equipment quantities, and deliverables found in the procurement documents.

Product Specification.value: Dell Latitude 5550 featuring an Intel Core Ultra 5 125U processor (12 MB cache, 12 cores, 14 threads, up to 4.3 GHz Turbo), Windows 11 Pro, 16 GB DDR5 RAM (2 x 8 GB, 5600 MT/s), 256 GB M.2 2230 TLC Gen 4 PCIe NVMe SSD, 15.6" FHD (1920x1080) 60Hz IPS Non-Touch display, Integrated Intel graphics, English US backlit AI hotkey keyboard, Intel Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 wireless, 3-cell 54 Wh ExpressCharge capable battery, and 65W USB Type-C AC adapter, Microsoft Copilot ready.

Invoicing Instructions:

• Contractor name, mailing address, social security number or Federal Tax ID number, and phone number.
• Reference the States assigned PORFP number.
• Date, invoice number and amount due.
3. Proof of delivery including packing slip or delivery confirmation, and equipment serial numbers.
